components.name: Primary button
components.description: Contextual approval or primary task action.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:37px;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;}.ds-primary{border:0;background:var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);color:var(--aka-colors-surface-card, #FFFFFF);}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--aka-colors-accent-hover, #10599c);}.ds-primary:disabled{background:#edf0f5;color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px;}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-primary{min-height:40px;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:37px;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;}.ds-secondary{border:1px solid var(--aka-colors-border-strong, #9AA6B5);background:var(--aka-colors-surface-card, #FFFFFF);color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--aka-colors-surface-subtle, #F8FAFC);border-color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px;}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-secondary{min-height:40px;}}

components.name: Text button
components.css: .ds-text{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:37px;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;}.ds-text{border:0;padding-inline:3px;background:none;color:var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);}.ds-text:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px;}

components.name: Global search
components.description: Quiet search field with focus-within treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-search" dir="rtl"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="חיפוש במרחב" placeholder="חיפוש ביישובים, פניות וידע"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--aka-colors-border-default, #E4EBF2);border-radius:6px;background:var(--aka-colors-surface-subtle, #F8FAFC);color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);}.ds-search input{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);width:100%;min-width:0;background:none;border:0;outline:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--aka-colors-text-primary, #0E131C);}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);opacity:1;}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);outline:2px solid var(--aka-colors-accent-soft, #f0f7ff);}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-search{height:35px;padding-inline:9px;}.ds-search input{font-size:11px;}}

components.name: Rail navigation
components.description: Current page uses blue text on pale blue.
components.html: עבודהזיכרון ארגוניתהליכים
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);display:grid;gap:5px;background:var(--aka-colors-surface-subtle, #F8FAFC);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 13px;color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);text-decoration:none;}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--aka-colors-border-default, #E4EBF2);}.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);background:var(--aka-colors-accent-soft, #f0f7ff);font-weight:650;}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px;}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-nav{display:flex;gap:2px;}.ds-nav a{padding:12px 9px;gap:6px;font-size:12px;border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;white-space:nowrap;}}

components.name: Warning flag
components.description: A labelled blocker; the warning variant hides the status dot.

components.name: Work surface
components.html:
התחשבנות פינוי

חיובים, התאמות ומקורות באותו מקום.
components.css: .ds-surface{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);background:var(--aka-colors-surface-card, #FFFFFF);color:var(--aka-colors-text-primary, #0E131C);border:1px solid var(--aka-colors-border-default, #E4EBF2);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}.ds-surface-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:25px 25px 22px;}.ds-surface h2{margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.015em;}.ds-surface p{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;max-width:65ch;}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-surface-heading{padding:20px 17px;gap:14px;}.ds-surface h2{font-size:16px;}.ds-surface p{font-size:11px;}}

components.name: Compact settlement identity
components.description: Static cell specimen for the real AG Grid compact row; no grid runtime is embedded.
components.css: .ds-compact{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;height:60px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0;}.ds-compact>span{font-size:12px;color:var(--aka-colors-text-secondary, #5A6879);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-record{font-family:var(--font, "Heebo", "Assistant", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif);background:none;border:0;padding:3px 0;color:var(--aka-colors-text-primary, #0E131C);font-size:12px;font-weight:550;text-align:start;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;}.ds-record:hover{color:var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}.ds-record:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--aka-colors-accent-main, #1977cc);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px;}

narrative.overview:
An operational white workbench for municipal staff: dense records, a quiet navigation rail, compact controls and contextual actions. Hebrew RTL and a shared record identity connect work, organisational memory and workflows.

The implementation adopts AKA theme revision `776496e`, with native-DOM adaptations and workspace-specific typography and layout. This file describes reused styles in the current code; provenance, the direction contract and demo boundaries remain in [docs/WORKSPACE-UX.md](docs/WORKSPACE-UX.md). [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) remains the separate product/architecture brief.
keyCharacteristics: White work surfaces and a quiet navigation rail.
Hebrew-first native typography and tabular operational numbers.
Real AG Grid tables, semantic flags and contextual record details.

rules.name: The Semantic Status Rule
rules.body: Use neutral dots for routine or ready states, labelled warning flags for blockers, green for verified actions, and blue for actions, selection and investigation.

rules.name: The Contextual Records Rule
rules.body: Open the same record beside the current task; on smaller screens, present its details as a modal inspector.

dos: Do use the adopted AKA semantic colors and the implemented Hebrew-first stack.
Do retain the compact identity, amount and status presentation for mobile settlement rows.
Do keep record actions, source evidence and history in their record context.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, labelled statuses and reduced-motion behavior.
